Ravi: FYI we finished the bounded-window-prefetcher v0.3 canary. Short summary: p50 -9ms, p95 -30ms, p99 -60ms across mixed chat + assistant workloads. Cost per 1k tokens ~7% lower.
Jules: Awesome. Is this the version with adaptive-window-sizing?
Ravi: Yes. v0.3 adds adaptive-window-sizing + backpressure aware prefetch. That reduced wasted fetches during bursty tails.
Anya: Any regressions on cold starts or KV cache pressure?
Ravi: Tested cold starts with empty prefix cache; cold p50 increased by ~3ms but warm wins dominate overall. KV hit ratio unchanged. Memory delta +2.1% per pod.
SRE-bot: canary deploy complete: checks OK (latency, errors, mem). 4h window.
Elliot: Can you paste the canary metrics and the default knobs?
Ravi: Canary metrics (trimmed):
```
canary: bounded-window-prefetcher-v0.3
duration: 4h
routes: assistant.streaming, chat.real-time
requests: 920k
p50: -9ms
p95: -30ms
p99: -60ms
mem: +2.1% per-pod
cpu: +1.2% avg
cost_per_1k_tokens: -7%
errors: no increase
```
Config defaults used in canary: `window_max=64`, `window_min=4`, `adaptive_alpha=0.18`, `burst_backoff=0.25`.
Jules: Nice. Any special observability additions we need?
Ravi: Added metrics: `prefetch_candidates`, `prefetch_success_ratio`, `adaptive_window_size`, and `backpressure_throttle`. Priya in Console team has a PR to add these to the runtime dashboard.
Anya: Rollout plan? We should be careful with Dedicated customers on strict latency SLOs.
Ravi: Plan: canary -> 20% (12h) -> 50% (24h) -> 100% (48h). Gate: default-off for Dedicated clusters; toggle via route policy. Auto-rollback triggers: p99 increase >10% over baseline OR error rate spike >2x.
Elliot: Who owns rollback ops? We should make rollback CLI commands obvious.
Ravi: SRE owns execution. Runbook snippet: `deploy rollback bounded-window-prefetcher --target classic-prefetcher && scale-set lookaside-pods 0` then `invalidate-prefetch-cache --prefix shared/`. Full runbook linked in the canary doc.
SRE-bot: rollback hooks registered in incident playbook.
Jules: Can we do an A/B with quantized kernels on some GPU types to see combined savings?
Ravi: Good idea. I'll open a follow-up canary ticket to test with quant-kernels on A100-40 and H100-small.
Anya: Please coordinate with Sales for customer comms once we hit 50%. Dedicated customers must opt-in; add a brief to the customer-facing changelog.
Elliot: Thumbs up. Schedule a 10m ops check at 09:45 tomorrow to validate dashboards.
Ravi: Scheduled. Thanks all :rocket:
